card.name: The .gov ending of FDA web addresses
card.fires_on: The ".gov" (or ".cfm") part of an FDA web address, right after "fda" in a link such as www.fda.gov/CompanionDiagnostics. It is mainly seen in label text that points readers to FDA web pages.

modes.label: fda.gov link ending
modes.description: The ".gov" piece right after "fda" in a URL that directs readers to FDA pages on companion diagnostics or REMS.
